correctness.rationale: The complex consists of pairwise-intersecting families of 35 three-subsets of [7], equivalently Ind(KG(3,1)); rational degree concentration and Betti ranks 29 (degree 6) and 7 (degree 9) are an explicit external theorem of Feng 2026 (Theorem 18), with full proof read and correctly delimited. For each six-subset S, the ten complementary triple pairs give an embedded (S0)^*10 = S9; independently checked the seven chosen 10-vertex maximal 9-simplex detectors, no outside triple compatible with them, and diagonal cohomology pairings, proving a rational basis. The stabilizer S6 acts on each sphere by sign, giving Λ^6 Q7 and trace sign(g)*F1(g). Independently constructed orbit-conflict graphs and evaluated exact signed reduced Lefschetz sums for all fifteen S7 conjugacy types; every class agrees with H6 trace 1+(1+sign(g))*(F3(g)-F2(g)), using Lefschetz L=traceH6-traceH9. Young-rule subset-character identities and conjugate partitions give the stated irreducible S7 decomposition and one invariant line. No integral homology classification, geometric H6 basis or k>1 generalization is asserted.
